description: Source code for WebmElement class and related Webm media track and segment handling, part of Android's media stagefright library, dealing with WebM media container elements.

classes.name: WebmElement
classes.description: Base class representing a WebM element with serialization and size calculation methods.

classes.name: WebmUnsigned
classes.description: Represents an unsigned integer WebM element.

classes.name: WebmBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary WebM element, typically containing raw data.

classes.name: WebmSimpleBlock
classes.description: Represents a simple block of media data within WebM.

classes.name: EbmlVoid
classes.description: Represents a void element used for padding or placeholder in WebM.

classes.name: WebmMaster
classes.description: Represents a master WebM element containing child elements.

methods.name: serializePayloadSize
methods.description: Serializes the size of the payload.

methods.name: serializeInto
methods.description: Serializes the entire element into a buffer.

methods.name: totalSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of the element including header and payload.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the element into a newly allocated buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the serialized element to a file descriptor.

methods.name: CuePointEntry
methods.description: Creates a cue point entry WebM element.

methods.name: SeekEntry
methods.description: Creates a seek entry WebM element.

methods.name: EbmlHeader
methods.description: Creates an EBML header WebM element.

methods.name: SegmentInfo
methods.description: Creates a segment info WebM element.

methods.name: AudioTrackEntry
methods.description: Creates an audio track entry WebM element.

methods.name: VideoTrackEntry
methods.description: Creates a video track entry WebM element.
